preserved: Each direct glyph uses the complete FontKey resolved by the pipeline for its normalized GlyphFontRequest; with two supplied fonts sharing the same glyph_id, the visible outline is the one belonging to that resolved identity
violated: The exporter probes incidental fonts by glyph_id, chooses a different face, uses collection position or silently defaults to the first font
unknown: The request has no association, maps to conflicting FontKeys, the mapped FontKey is absent from the supplied collection, or identity cannot be established uniquely
mechanics_outside_gate: Font collection index, lookup data structure, traversal order and XML identifier spelling

preserved: Equal normalized requests within one compilation resolve to the same complete FontKey; base_char, requested family, variant, variations and mathematically relevant resolution state distinguish requests when they affect the chosen face
violated: Occurrence identity, address, traversal position or an incomplete key merges observably different faces or splits equal requests into inconsistent results
unknown: The available carriers cannot establish that two requests are equal or distinct, or equal keys have conflicting resolved results
mechanics_outside_gate: Hash algorithm, field serialization and map iteration order

preserved: The visible contour of the selected glyph_id from the resolved face is preserved, including holes, curves and the selected mathematical variant
violated: A different glyph, tofu, base_char substitute, missing contour or observably altered contour is emitted
unknown: The face is invalid, glyph_id is absent, outline extraction is unsupported, or the glyph is an image/color glyph outside the demonstrated outline fragment
mechanics_outside_gate: Path command spelling, point ordering that yields the same contour, defs/use choice and deduplication strategy

preserved: The glyph contour appears at the FrameItem::Glyph position and at size / units_per_em scale exactly once
violated: Position, scale or baseline differs observably; translation or scale is omitted or applied more than once
unknown: Position or size is non-finite, units_per_em is zero, or the landmark cannot distinguish the transform
mechanics_outside_gate: Matrix factorization, transform attribute placement and numeric lexical spelling when morphology is equal

preserved: An asymmetric outline has the intended upright visible orientation after exactly one font-space Y inversion
violated: The outline is vertically mirrored, remains in font Y-up space, or is inverted twice
unknown: The chosen outline is vertically symmetric or has insufficient landmarks to distinguish orientation
mechanics_outside_gate: Whether inversion is baked into path coordinates or represented by an SVG transform

preserved: The glyph interior carries style.fill with the same visible color and alpha, including under ancestor transforms
violated: Fill hue, coverage or alpha changes, disappears, becomes opaque, or leaks to another glyph
unknown: The paint kind is outside the supported observation, depends on unavailable parent-space information, or cannot be rendered by the oracle
mechanics_outside_gate: Color lexical form, attribute versus style spelling and equivalent paint-server IDs

preserved: Every direct glyph piece in a mathematical assembly uses its own resolved request and preserves the visible multi-piece morphology, positions, scale and fill without joining, dropping or substituting pieces
violated: Any piece is missing, duplicated, uses a wrong face or glyph, overlaps incorrectly, or is synthesized from base_char in place of the selected assembly
unknown: Any required piece has absent or ambiguous association, unavailable face, invalid scale or missing outline; the whole assembly claim remains Unknown rather than partially Preserved
mechanics_outside_gate: Number and order of defs, reuse of equal outlines and IDs when all visible pieces remain equivalent

preserved: Ancestor and glyph-local transforms compose once so the final contour, position and fill occupy the intended page-space geometry
violated: A transform is ignored, reordered non-equivalently or applied twice, changing the visible contour or location
unknown: A transform is non-finite, non-representable or observationally ambiguous for the selected outline
mechanics_outside_gate: Equivalent matrix decomposition and nesting of g/use/path elements

preserved: x_advance remains layout geometry already reflected by external placement; exporting one direct glyph does not reshape text, move subsequent items or recalculate the cursor
violated: The exporter applies x_advance again, performs shaping, or changes subsequent page-space positions
unknown: The observation lacks a subsequent landmark or layout carrier capable of distinguishing cursor movement
mechanics_outside_gate: Whether x_advance is read but ignored internally

preserved: Reordering the supplied font collection leaves every request mapped to the same complete FontKey and produces the same visible glyph morphology and verdict
violated: Reordering changes the selected face, outline, fill, position or a Preserved/Unknown classification
unknown: A required FontKey is absent or ambiguous in either collection, so no preservation claim can be made
mechanics_outside_gate: Output byte order, defs order and renaming of equivalent IDs

preserved: Wrappers explicitly supplied without fonts retain the documented scope-out and do not fabricate an outline or textual fallback
violated: A wrapper invents system-font, network-font, base_char text, tofu or an incidental outline and labels it preserved
unknown: The canonical verdict for a direct glyph requiring a font in this wrapper is Unknown; omission alone is not promoted to Preserved
mechanics_outside_gate: Presence of unrelated non-glyph SVG content

preserved: Repeated evaluation of the same frozen requests, FontKey associations, font bytes and frames yields identical per-glyph semantic observations and verdicts
violated: A repeated or reordered run changes font identity, contour landmarks, page-space geometry, paint or verdict
unknown: Any underlying case is canonically Unknown; repetition must reproduce Unknown and never upgrade it
mechanics_outside_gate: Whole-document bytes, base64, XML attribute order, defs order and generated ID spelling
